capabilities: Sync encrypted notes and attachments to a WebDAV server
Create or join an encrypted vault with a shared passphrase
Resolve conflicts from immutable encrypted revisions
Pair devices through the post-quantum encryption mode
Reach the home server remotely through an SSH tunnel and HTTPS gateway
extras: README is mostly Chinese with partial English sections. PQC mode is a beta preview with its own plugin ID and remote directory; it needs a separate per-vault submission service and its own backup of the database snapshot plus recovery package. A lost vault passphrase cannot be reset, and the encryption format has not undergone an external security audit. Migrating from Remotely Save requires decrypting, backing up, and re-uploading to a new remote directory.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault to a self-hosted WebDAV server with encrypted contents, file names and paths.

relations.evidence: Existing Remotely Save vaults use another format, including rclone crypt.

requires.name: self-hosted HTTPS submission service (witness/server.py) for PQC mode

summary: End-to-end encrypted vault sync to your own WebDAV server, using a shared passphrase or post-quantum device pairing.
